subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Beret Society's gathering place

140050101.text: We are honored by your visit, Your Grace. All of us at the Society have been waiting for your arrival.

140050103.text: #Mm-hmm. Let me introduce you to them. {NICKNAME}, this is Dougier, the head of the Beret Society. This is their gathering place.

140050104.text: Members can find all sorts of drinks and snacks here, as well as a large variety of books and other resources.

140050105.text: Every once in a while, the Society will also host activities and seminars, which are always well-attended.

140050106.text: You flatter me, Your Grace. All we did was set up an organization in the same way as you would in the world above.

140050107.text: It's so easy to feel lonely and helpless when you arrive here for the first time. I remember that feeling all too well. None of us knew anything about this place then, after all.

140050108.text: But that's when the thought came to me. If we could help everyone turn over a new leaf, they would no longer have to lead such gloomy existences.

140050109.text: Thus, it was with your help that I founded the Beret Society.

140050110.text: Oh, so you were also involved with this, Wriothesley?

140050111.text: Ah, my part in this was minimal. All I did was follow procedure and rubber stamp the application.

140050112.text: I'm sure you have a very good sense of what this place is about by now. As you know, not everyone takes their sentence seriously — for some, this is just another place where they can eat, breathe, and sleep.

140050113.text: But the Society is a great place for those who wish to turn things around.

140050114.text: Exactly right. Here, we'll keep an eye on each other, and remind each other of our goals. Everyone can focus on rehabilitating our mental states, and even make many new friends.

140050115.text: Our operations are entirely funded by members' donated goods and Credit Coupons. Same for the things you see here.

140050116.text: Who knew you could find such a place in the Fortress of Meropide...

140050117.text: Oh, right, and what's the deal with the hats?

140050118.text: Ah, there's nothing deep about it. I just felt like we needed some kind of visible identifier.

140050119.text: If our members felt joy and pride from being a part of this group, then the hats would become a point of pride for them as well.

140050120.text: And when we're together, we will feel a sense of community from seeing everyone's hats.

140050121.text: Optimism, community, hard work, and a desire for a new life... I hope this hat will show everyone everything we have been working towards.

140050122.text: In other words, that hat has come to represent something like a model citizen, which also helps them recruit new members.

140050123.text: Once again, you are exactly right, Your Grace. That's a part of our goal as well. Let's take a little 'ol seat over here — there's no need for us to stand.

140050124.text: I'll ask the members to get us some drinks. Please wait just one moment. Feel free to look around, too, if you want to learn more about us.

140050127.text: Oh, right! What happened to your slow day, Wriothesley?

140050128.text: Seems like I shouldn't underestimate an adventurer's keen sense of observation. I'll bear that in mind the next time I need to do something low key...

140050129.text: Kidding of course. We're just discussing some small matters. It shouldn't take long.

140050130.text: We've also already gone over the organization's vision. Instead of listening to me try to explain some more, maybe it'd be better if you took a look around for yourself.

140050131.text: Why does Paimon feel like he didn't answer the question at all... Eh. Well, we're already here, aren't we?

140050132.text: Yeah, might as well take a look.

140050133.text: Yeah, they're supposed to be like, the model prisoners, right? So this is what their spot looks like...

subQuests.subQuestName: Chat with the members of the Beret Society

140050201.text: Hey, what are you doing over here?

140050202.text: Oh, hello, you are guests of the Duke, are you not? I'm organizing the bookshelves. Want to take a look?

140050203.text: We've got some classics, as well as a few books that the members published themselves.

140050204.text: There are writers in the Society?

140050205.text: Yeah. Most of them are writing diaries or autobiographies on their time in the organization.

140050206.text: Some quit drinking, some learned to tailor, some became real good at calligraphy, and even I've learned to use a Kamera...

140050207.text: Hah, we find it kind of funny, you see, had we managed to stay above ground, none of us would have ever had the time to learn any of those skills.

140050208.text: Ah, it's all because you have a lot more free time now...

140050209.text: Not only that, but we've also now got the mental space to think about taking on new things. Before we came here, we were constantly exhausted just trying to live.

140050210.text: With how the Duke and Mr. Dougier have organized our lives down here, though, all we need to do is think about the things that we want to do.

140050211.text: You never know what you may be good at until you give it a try.

140050212.text: And while you're here, no matter what you do, you won't get judged for it. After all, there's no need to conform to societal expectations when you're already in jail.

140050213.text: So this is something like a safe space...

140050214.text: Yeah, that's exactly right. After all, not everyone is good at fighting, or have the physical strength to do hard labor. The Society is exactly what some of us need.

140050215.text: And that's it, I just finished organizing this shelf as well, so feel free to check it out if you want. Just remember to put the books back after you're done!

subQuests.subQuestName: Chat with the members of the Beret Society

140050301.text: Welcome to our gathering place. Is there anything you'd like me to explain to you?

140050302.text: Oh, it's okay, we're just taking a look around...

140050305.text: Well, that's not a bad comparison. It is my job to explain our amenities and benefits to our latest members.

140050306.text: I'm sure Mr. Dougier has already explained some of it, but allow me to fill you in some more.

140050307.text: Besides this space, which our members use to rest and relax, we also have an entertainment room, a fitness room, and a self-study room.

140050308.text: These rooms are open to all of our members. We want everyone to be able to use their free time to the fullest.

140050309.text: Wow, that's pretty cool! Do you have a restaurant, too? If you did, you also wouldn't have to eat at the big cafeteria anymore...

140050310.text: Unfortunately, we don't. For matters like that, we still have to rely on His Grace.

140050311.text: We started a collaboration with the Cafeteria a while back, though, so they'll let us borrow their kitchen to do some simple research into recipes and cooking.

140050313.text: Yeah, Paimon can definitely see how it'd be easier to live your life if you had all this support.

140050314.text: Yep, and that's exactly why Mr. Dougier founded the Society.

140050315.text: We all think we made the correct choice to join him.

subQuests.subQuestName: Chat with the members of the Beret Society

140050402.text: Uh, hello? Are you talking to Paimon?

140050403.text: Yep, I'm talking to you. Now, why don't you follow my lead and take a deep breath, before letting everything out like this?

140050408.text: Haha, that's how I pump myself up every day. A lot of my friends have found it super useful, too.

140050409.text: With one shout, you can release all the fatigue, resentment and unpleasantness from your lungs, and return to the day with all the optimism in the world!

140050410.text: Why don't you also give it a try? I promise that it will work!

140050412.text: Hahaha, feeling shy? That's alright. As long as you remember this trick, it will come in handy one day.

140050413.text: Just remember to take a deep breath and let it all out if you find yourself at your wit's end.

140050601.text: Alright, we've talked to everybody... It sure sounds like they're all pretty happy.

140050602.text: That would explain why Wriothesley only had good things to say about this place.

140050603.text: Huh, it looks like they're starting to wrap up their conversation as well. Let's go over to them.

140050604.text: Of course, Your Grace. I will attend to those matters right away.

140050605.text: Okay, then I don't have anything else to add. Oh, you're back — what did you think about this place?

140050606.text: Now, note that your review will also affect my review of Dougier and the Society as a whole.

140050607.text: Wait. I didn't know they were also a part of the evaluation process...

140050608.text: It's all right with me, though. I'm pretty confident about our growth and activities.

140050610.text: Don't think anyone expected you to get a society going here of all places!

140050612.text: Ah, so it seems that you were able to get a sense of our vision and values. That's all I can ask for, really.

140050615.text: The prisoners here all have very different personalities and psychological needs.

140050616.text: Our needs are like violent beasts. If we can't face them properly, they'll grow restless and enraged, causing pain and conflict.

140050617.text: But if we can placate them, they will lose their fangs, and even be converted into fuel for far nobler pursuits.

140050618.text: Which is why in my opinion, learning to reconcile with oneself is the first step on the path to redemption.

140050619.text: You've hit the nail on the head, Your Grace. Before I founded the Society, I had met too many people who could not come to terms with themselves...

140050620.text: And I'm sure that a part of your support is rooted in your desire to help those people find their way.

140050621.text: And Paimon thought everyone was enjoying life just fine working and fighting...

140050622.text: Of course, that lifestyle is more than enough for some people in the Fortress. For others, though, they would just be useless distractions.

140050623.text: Speaking of fightin'... I'm not sure if you knew this, but even His Grace sometimes fights in the ring.

140050624.text: Whaaat!? You fight in the ring, too? Wearing those hi-tech boxing gloves of yours...?

140050614.text: Ah... Yeah, you're right. By themselves, our resources probably don't feel like much.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the Beret Society's gathering place

140050701.text: Huh, it's just as Wriothesley said... Seems like Dougier's no longer here.

140050702.text: You said you felt there was something off about this place, right? So let's see if we can feel something out.

140050703.text: Paimon will do her best to help!

140050707.text: We're really sorry, we just realized that we'd lost something, and we figured we might have left it here by accident! We'll be on our way as soon as we find it.

140050709.text: Did anyone see a glass bottle by any chance?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the members of the Beret Society again

140055201.text: Are you still organizing the bookshelves?

140055202.text: Yeah, and, I'm sorry, but... you can't check out the books right now.

140055203.text: We weren't thinking about that to begin with! But weren't you super friendly just a moment ago?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the members of the Beret Society again

140055502.text: Hello... How can I help you?

140055503.text: Can you give us that run-down again?

140055504.text: The Beret Society offers a variety of resources and benefits to its members, and... Uh... I mean, you've already heard my spiel. I don't know anything beyond what I've already told you.

140055506.text: Ah, sorry, that's not what I meant... It's just... There's nothing more I can tell you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the members of the Beret Society again

140055703.text: Isn't this how you greeted us earlier? Take a deep breath, and let it all out...

140055704.text: Oh, yeah, that's right, you sure are a fast learner...

140055706.text: Uh, I ate something earlier, so I'm falling into a bit of a food coma, and uh... I mean, not everyone can be super upbeat all the time, right?

140055707.text: You're looking for something, you said? I didn't see it, but it should be somewhere nearby...

140055401.text: You really can't check them out... Please understand...

140055601.text: Please... Please just leave me alone...

140055801.text: I didn't see it... Why don't you try to look for it somewhere else?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the members of the Beret Society again

140050801.text: Oh, you're back. How were things at their headquarters?

140050802.text: It was as if they had all turned into completely different people...

140050805.text: Hmm, that would prove my suspicions.

140050806.text: The "dissonance" I mentioned earlier was precisely that fleeting moment of fear behind the cheerful facade.

140050807.text: Like that one guy we found hiding in the box.

140050808.text: Right, he was acting super scared too when we saw him at the gathering place!

140050809.text: Hmm... Actually, hasn't he just been acting super paranoid since we first met?

140050810.text: And that is precisely why I took his hat.

140050811.text: Oh, so the one who started it all was...

140050813.text: It's because I wanted to figure out what's really going on.

140050814.text: I don't believe any of Dougier's talk about unstable mental states.

140050815.text: How long have you been investigating this?

140050816.text: Not too long. Dougier made very elaborate preparations for my visit, but I don't know... it almost feels like the performance was too elaborate.

140050817.text: Okay, but if you think something's wrong, why don't you just take the whole Society into custody?

140050818.text: Aren't you the Duke? You can do whatever you want in this place.

140050819.text: Haha, maybe you're actually a better fit for the position than I am. Just give me the word, and I'll hand you the cuffs.

140050820.text: In all seriousness, however, cuffs and the like should be used sparingly. They're mostly for show.

140050821.text: Everything I do is on display. The way people see me act determines the kind of world I can create down here.

140050822.text: And I've always striven to appear fair and reasonable to the people.

140050823.text: Uhh... That sounds a bit deep. Paimon's not sure she got all of it...

subQuests.subQuestName: Meet up with Wriothesley as you agreed

140051101.text: I apologize for my lack of composure. These two are the guests that came with you to our gathering place, correct?

140051103.text: Yes, my lover Faissolle told me all about you. Please help us, Your Grace, he's in great danger right now...

140051104.text: Slow down, take a deep breath, and start from the top. What happened at the Society?

140051105.text: I'm sorry, Your Grace, I will try... I think I should start from when you saw Faissolle last.

140051106.text: You mean, when we saw him at the gathering place?

140051107.text: Yes, he fled immediately, but many members are hot on his heels.

140051108.text: Thankfully, he still managed to meet up with me, and explain everything that had happened.

140051109.text: Now that he's lost Dougier's trust, what awaits him is agonizing "censure."

140051111.text: Censure is Dougier's method of establishing control, as well as the thing we all fear the most.

140051112.text: Rather than listening to me explain what it is, Your Grace, please just let me show it to you...

140051113.text: Every secret may be found within—

140051115.text: Ah, here you are. I was wondering where you had run off to in such a hurry.

140051116.text: Please excuse us, Your Grace. It was never our intention to disturb you like this. You see, Avice's mental state has been rather unstable ever since she arrived at the Fortress...

140051117.text: She rambles often, and has hallucinations. It may be best to dismiss her babbling as random gibberish.

140051118.text: I don't recall hearing a knock, or giving permission for you to come in.

140051119.text: My apologies. I merely did not wish for Your Grace to be alarmed. Had I not been so focused on recovering her, I would have followed all the rules of etiquette to the letter. So, please forgive my discourtesy.

140051124.text: Please, there's no need to be upset. It's only natural to want to side with the poor, sick girl, but I know His Grace to be a reasonable man.

140051125.text: Well then, what if the reasonable man wants to hear the lunatic out?

140051126.text: That would be perfectly fine with me. Oh, and just so you know, we've also found the missing Mr. Faissolle. I have no idea why he was so upset about losing his hat, really.

140051127.text: Thankfully, he has already returned to his senses. We've brought him back to our place, so there's no need to worry.

140051129.text: I'm sorry, Your Grace... I don't have anything more to say.

140051130.text: This is what you're afraid of, correct? You can tell me everything. I'll do all I can for you.

140051132.text: I've never seen that thing in my life.

140051135.text: Your Grace, I don't think there's anything else she would like to say. Pressuring her will not get you anywhere.

140051137.text: It's alright, Avice. As long as you tell me what it is that you're terrified of...

140051138.text: No matter what it is, it will no longer be able to hurt you. I swear this on my name and honor as the Duke.

140051139.text: Your Grace... *sigh* Forget it. I'll keep my mouth shut. I've already said everything I could say about the matter.

140051140.text: I'm sorry, Your Grace, but I really don't have anything more to say. Please... don't press me further.

140051142.text: In that case, Avice and I will be off. Once again, please accept my apologies for disturbing your peaceful evening, Your Grace.

140051143.text: Miss Avice, please show me your head. That is an order.

140051144.text: Wriothesley proceeds to examine Avice's head, but does not find anything suspicious.

140051146.text: Your Grace, I know you have long tired of my words, but please believe me when I say you've merely let your worries get to your head.

140051147.text: The Society has never caused trouble for you or any of the guards at the Fortress. We've spent all of our time working hard and trying to lead better lives.

140051148.text: Why are you doing everything in your power to prove our "guilt"? What's wrong with the current state of affairs?

140051149.text: I'll do anything for you as long as you give me the word. Why are you so intent on getting rid of someone who's been unfalteringly loyal?

140051150.text: Your words bore me. You know the consequences if I find you to be lying.

140051151.text: Everything that I do, I do for the Fortress of Meropide. But Your Grace is welcome to visit us anytime to confirm the true intent of our activities.

140054002.text: What a coincidence. So do I.

140054003.text: Huh? What is it? Tell Paimon about it!

140054007.text: So, she handed a key piece of evidence over to us without Dougier noticing.

140054008.text: That would mean that Avice didn't stay silent out of fear. She stayed silent because she'd already given us what we needed.

140054010.text: Wriothesley tinkers with the hair clip for a brief moment.

140054011.text: I managed to remove this from the hair clip. It's long, slender, and conical, it's hollow on the inside, and looks something like a cross between a nail and a thorn.

140054013.text: Let's see... What if we do this?

140054014.text: Hey, what are you doing... Wait, some kind of dark liquid is leaking out of the gem...

140054015.text: And... some of it has been absorbed by this thorny-looking thing...

140054016.text: The gem is used as a container for a type of liquid.

140054017.text: You've probably heard before that water is filled with the strongest emotions of humanity.

140054018.text: With that in mind, this liquid is probably a highly concentrated solution of "fear."

140054019.text: Ooh, so that's why even touching it will make you remember unpleasant things!

140054021.text: Dougier would be able to "censure" others. I can only imagine how it would feel to have this directly injected into your brain...

140054022.text: The moment it hits you... would be like being flooded with all the terrors you've ever experienced in your life.

140054023.text: Agony, desolation, and an overwhelming sense of despair... No wonder they're all so terrified of it.

140054024.text: So... was the hat meant to cover up their wounds?

140054025.text: That might not even be all. Let's go get them right away.

140054026.text: We can't let Dougier escape with all of the evidence.

140051001.text: Oh, here you are. Did you manage to land a lucky pull on the Welfare Meals tonight?

140051002.text: Let's just get straight to the point! Has anything else happened with the Society?

140051003.text: Patience, Paimon. Even as the situation continues to brew, we still need to make sense of what we've learned so far, and go over any sticking points.

140051004.text: I'm actually still thinking about the first thing that came to my mind when I noticed something amiss. Namely:

140051005.text: Why didn't anyone come to me about it?

140051006.text: Oh, that's a good point! Could whatever they're afraid of be so powerful that even you won't be able to do anything about it?

140051007.text: But even if such a thing existed, how could they be so sure without checking with me first?

140051008.text: It'd be one thing if it was just one or two people, but it seems like everyone's convinced that I won't be able to help.

140051009.text: Which leads me to believe that it's more likely that they think I just wouldn't care to help them.

140051012.text: Yes, something like that. Dougier must have told them something to make them think I won't take their side.

140051013.text: So it became imperative for me to refute that, and prove my true stance.

140051014.text: Of course, I had originally planned to do this in a more covert way, but I had to improvise when you identified the guy who'd lost his hat with everyone present.

140051015.text: There was no way to keep our investigation a secret after that.

140051016.text: That makes sense... Wait, then does that mean it was all Paimon's fault?

140051018.text: The last thing that guy wanted was for Dougier to find out that he'd lost it. He would've never brought the matter up on his own.

140051019.text: But now, not only has Dougier found out that he'd lost his hat, he's also realized that we were the ones who found it...

140051020.text: That likely set his internal alarms off all at once.

140051021.text: The hats must be hiding something...

140051022.text: Yes, that's the conclusion I came to as well. It's the only thing that could explain the fear.

140051023.text: If we didn't act right then and there, Dougier would probably come up with some other way to hide the truth, and we'd be back to square one.

140051024.text: So after giving the matter some thought, I tossed that black gem onto the ground.

140051025.text: I must say, I was pretty satisfied with the results.

140051026.text: Ah, so you did that on purpose!?

140051027.text: Yes, that's right. Of course, that box was discovered as a part of our investigation of the Society from the very beginning.

140051028.text: I had no way to know if any of the members had actually seen the gem before, but since I had to do something, I decided to gamble.

140051029.text: So that's the "hint" you were talking about earlier.

140051030.text: Right, and I said back there that I had no idea what the gem represented. That should've been enough to let people know that it's still early days for my investigation.

140051031.text: And since I was traveling with you, heroes who have never turned a blind eye to evil and injustice...

140051032.text: They would also understand that we're here to help, rather than to tolerate or uphold the status quo.

140051033.text: You used us as a part of your plan, too!

140051034.text: So that's why you wanted us to come along.

140051035.text: My apologies. There was no time and quite a lot to explain, so I figured it might be easier to just let you see a few things for yourselves.

140051036.text: But I can assure you that I've now told you everything there is to know.

140051037.text: Of course, you're under no obligation, but I would really appreciate it if you could continue to lend me your support and help me figure out the true secret behind the Society.

140051038.text: Would you be willing to lend me your support?

140051039.text: Ugh, but Paimon's still mad at you...

140051201.text: Argh, just what's up with that guy!? He makes Paimon really, really mad!

140051202.text: We should have shown him his place!

140051203.text: Sooner or later, all will pay the price for their arrogance.

140051204.text: He must have been well-prepared for this exact scenario, or he wouldn't have dared to be so openly hostile — all the more reason for us to be patient.

140051205.text: The entire Society are his hostages. His subordinates would definitely react if he were taken into custody.

140051206.text: And that's why he dared to bare his fangs right in front of me.

140051209.text: The true secret of the Society is neither on the hat, nor on the members' heads.

140051210.text: Dougier probably knew this from the very beginning, which is why he didn't panic.

140051211.text: However, if we were to look at the rules, it would also seem like the head has to be the place where they're keeping all of their secrets.

140051212.text: Yeah, none of this makes sense to Paimon, either... What are they trying to hide?

140053001.text: (There's a good variety of books here, and it also looks like the selection is regularly updated. If nothing else, one can definitely find something here with which to pass the time.)

140053002.text: (A member's diary is also displayed among the books. It was probably included for recruitment purposes.)

140053101.text: Please check out as many books as you may like. Just don't forget to return them to their proper places once you're done.

140053201.text: Life at the Society is rich and fulfilling. We all enjoy it immensely.

140053301.text: There's no need to be embarrassed about it! Just embrace your emotions, and freely express it for all to hear!

140055001.text: The Society is planning to host another event soon. We haven't had many new recruits recently, so...

140055002.text: Ah, the one you mentioned to me before? The idea is sound, but I still have some concerns about the specifics...

140055101.text: Then... what are you gonna do?

140055102.text: Good question, what should I do... Hmm, maybe I'll drop by the Ring and sign myself up for a fight.

140055103.text: Wait, so you're really just gonna make us work while you slack off!?

140056001.text: Hmm... I should probably always keep a few Super Deluxe Welfare Meals in stock.

140059901.text: Okay, Paimon sees what you meant now...

140059902.text: Seems like they really don't want to talk to us, so let's just head back...

140059903.text: It's finally evening... Wriothesley's probably wrapped up his investigation.

140059904.text: Paimon has no idea what that guy's thinking... Let's just go find him and ask him what he's really up to.

140059905.text: (The hats are definitely being used to hide a secret. But there's nothing wrong with the hats themselves...)

140059906.text: (But if there's nothing on her head, why did Avice feel the need to remove her hat?)

140059907.text: (From the way Dougier acted, he must have known from the beginning that we wouldn't be able to find any evidence.)

140059908.text: (I need to think about this a bit more... Just what is Dougier trying to hide?)

140059909.text: (I can't seem to make a connection here.)
